notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.notes:
📝PATCH NOTES


Hey! It's GBoy here and I am super hyped to share with you our new update for Snail Mail. I love writing patch notes (internally) and this is my first patch note ever for a commercial game I have made. Without further ado, let's get into it!


 🕺🏾NEW DISCO CARD PACK! 

       Bring some groove in with this card pack!

DISCO BALL - 3 Stamps

Launch a disco ball that creates SPOTLIGHT spots. Landing on a spotlight spot gives an extra move, the same turn

RESERVATION - 3 Stamps

Reserve a block spot. Other snails cannot place blocks on this spot.

✨OLD PACKS BUT NEW CARDS
DDOS (Cyber Pack) - 4 Stamps

Teleport in a cyber snail. Place 2 GLITCHED tiles anywhere on the board.

Eddies (Oceanic Pack) - 4 Stamps

Bring in a scuba snail. Place 2 WHIRLPOOL tiles anywhere on the board

📦PRE-MADE DECKS
Premade Decks are live! Don’t wanna bother making your own decks? Play with some pre-built decks! Some are actual balanced decks, while some are more on the fun/challenging side! Pick your poison!

🔃CARD CHANGES
NULL CMD - 3 Stamps >> 2 Stamps

NULL CMD is not too strong / not too weak if used correctly, so we are reducing the stamp cost to fit its current place in the cards.

EDDIES / SCUBA SNAIL

Landing on a whirlpool will now, at the very least, move the snail 2 floors. It will still move the snail one floor if there is no other choice

FREESTYLE

I took it to a corner and obliterated it to hell. Permanently removed from the game as it was too powerful with no counter play

SNOWMAN

Decoy snowmen now take smarter movement decisions instead of moving randomly when the player moves

We heard a lot of feedback where people said it was very easy to figure out which snowman is the decoy because of the way it moves. Hopefully, with these changes, they feel much more “human”
😎CARD VISUAL CHANGES
In an effort to improve card clarity, text explaining the effects is now moved to hover. Hover on any text that's ALLCAPS in a card!
🏫TUTORIAL
Removed all the firewall blocks from the tutorial and replaced them with normal blocks to keep things simpler
🧱DECK BUILDER CHANGES
Max Stamps that you can spend has been increased from 40 >> 55
🐱‍🏍MISCELLANEOUS
Cloud saves have been implemented! Your decks are no longer saved locally and should now be shared across multiple devices.

Added a closed beta expression of interest pop-up that will appear after playing 2 games

Added a Discord button for our NEW server! Join us - we love seeing new faces!
🌐SOCIALS
We have a new discord server! Come join us, we love to see new faces! https://discord.gg/YfApAPxcXN
[hr][/hr]🐛BUG FIXES
Fixed an issue where the stamp cost would not update in the deck builder menu

Fixed an issue where the game would crash when leaving the lobby

Fixed an issue where floors that are already occupied would be highlighted

Fixed various crashes and softlock scenarios

And that's it for this update! Wishlist if you like the game, share the game with your friends and family, go pet a snail, go to a rooftop and scream about the game if you loved or hated it (or join our discord and scream at me). I will see you all in the next one! Stay safe!

- Gboy
